purpose: y2s65-thumbsync: Nord2Metal only (y2s64-thumbstage + kernel cache maintenance asked for). Before each GPU conversion of an imported YCbCr surface in MobileSlideShow the surface is locked and unlocked for writing (no byte touched): the kernel's IOSurface hook (tracking level 2) then marks every import of it CPU-dirty and the next GPU job naming it cleans its CPU cache lines (the SYNC selector's effect, which the library cannot reach) ('SURF gpu-dirty n=...'; off with /var/db/nord2-metal/no-gpu-dirty). The raw-check repeats its GPU copy after that marking ('gpu-after-mark='); its 'bo' value is the process's own IOSurface mapping (the same as cpu by construction). Backup Nord2Metal.pre-thumbsync; undo: guest-thumbsync-undo.sh (back to y2s64-thumbstage).
